title: Puppy with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='eyeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7fe7ff'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='30' rx='10' ry='18' fill='#8a5a2b' transform='rotate(-20 24 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='30' rx='10' ry='18' fill='#8a5a2b' transform='rotate(20 76 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='31' rx='5' ry='11' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(-20 25 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='75' cy='31' rx='5' ry='11' fill='#c98a4b' transform='rotate(20 75 31)'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#e0a75e'/>
  <!-- forehead patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#f4c98a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#f7d9a8'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='66' r='4' fill='#f6a9c8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='66' r='4' fill='#f6a9c8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='53' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='53' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='5' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='5' fill='url(#eyeGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='3' fill='#1a6b8a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='3' fill='#1a6b8a'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M35 47 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M65 47 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4a2c14'/>
  <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='63' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#b07a4a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 68 q-4 5 -8 3' stroke='#7a4a20' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 68 q4 5 8 3' stroke='#7a4a20' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M50 72 q-3 6 0 8 q3 -2 0 -8 z' fill='#ff7fa0'/>
</svg>
